content: Agents amplify flaws: hallucinated APIs at 5 to 22 percent, silent-default drift where agents invent plausible values for unspecified fields, self-confirming tests, scope creep, and pattern extrapolation that extends legacy antipatterns; silent no-ops let agents proceed on false premises. Mitigations are fail-visibly contracts, allow-lists, unhappy-path criteria, and retrieval grounding.
